horizon_goals.immediate_session_goal: Resolve the tension in the magnetic sea.

active_location.macro_silhouette: The obsidian shores of the ferrofluid sea curl under a heavy, storm-bruised sky. Dark magnetic waves crash against brass pylons, casting jagged shadows across the polished rock. In the distance, arcing static illuminates the misty horizon in flashes of cobalt.

sensory_palette.sight_and_color: Cobalt arcs over dark, rippling ferrofluid.
sensory_palette.sound: The deep hum of magnetic shear and crashing fluid.
sensory_palette.taste_optional: Copper on the back of the tongue.

interactive_features.affordance_description: Can be braced against to resist the magnetic pull of the shoreline.
Can be harvested for its dense, charged particulate matter.
Provides cover from the blinding static arcs rolling off the sea.

reactive_toys.motivation_goal: To destabilize the shoreline's magnetic polarity.
reactive_toys.consistent_method: Pulsing waves of disruptive kinetic force.
reactive_toys.immediate_complication: Threatens to invert Kaio's navigational compass.
reactive_toys.uninterrupted_escalation: Will eventually tear the brass pylons from the bedrock.

three_levels_of_why.level_1_immediate: Kaio must stabilize his navigation gear amidst the surge.
three_levels_of_why.level_2_local: The surge threatens the local supply caches along the shore.
three_levels_of_why.level_3_campaign_arc: Understanding the shear is vital to taming the ferrofluid sea.

graduated_outcomes.nat_1_false_intuition: Kaio misreads the surge and drops his compass into the sea.
graduated_outcomes.below_dc_complicated_fail_forward: Kaio struggles to hold his footing, bracing against the pylon but losing a map.
graduated_outcomes.meets_dc_clean_success: Kaio deftly recalibrates his compass while bracing against the shear.
graduated_outcomes.dc_plus_5_or_20_extended_lore: Kaio maps the shear perfectly, realizing it predicts the next major storm.

master_narrator.agency_handoff_prompt: With the compass secure, Kaio tosses it to Ryn. What do you do?
